item.tib: o rgyan lho nub dur khrod mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar mkha' 'gro'i bka' lung 'di/ dur khrod gnas brgyad mjal snang 'di/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yang / mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dpal gyis/ pha mas gtsor byas 'gro drug rnams/ dag pa'i gnas mchog u rgyan du/ gsang spyod rig 'dzin sa thob shog/ kha ba can ljongs bod yul du/ bstan pa mi nub dar rgyas nas/ mkha' la nyi shar bkra shis shog gnyen no/ gsang ngo //
